policy: ทุก import ข้าม layer ต้องอยู่ในกราฟนี้ — เพิ่ม edge ใหม่ต้อง approve
note: v2 — re-keyed after folder reorg (2026-07): lib/v2-rules, lib/v3-engines, lib/v4-ai, lib/v5-presenter, lib/v6-executor, lib/runtime, lib/shared, lib/supabase, lib/middleware, lib/documents, lib/transactions, lib/cognitive, lib/config, lib/agent, lib/macos, lib/platform, lib/drivers moved out of lib/ into purpose-named top-level folders. Same allowed relationships, new names; several old cross-layer edges are now same-layer self-imports.

notes.app_wide: app/ (pages + API routes) can import from all presentation and execution layers for command dispatch
notes.app_cognitive: app/api/chat/route.ts uses cognitive/pipeline for the cognitive command pipeline
notes.cognitive_all: cognitive/ orchestrates the full pipeline — imports from services, engines, presenter, gateway, plugins
notes.engines_self: engines sub-modules can import each other (e.g., debt/engine imports config-loader from core; documents/validation/transactions all share the engines/ folder now)
notes.services_no_gateway_call_out: services (ai/*) must not import core/runtime/engine directly — AI แปลอย่างเดียว ไม่ register command เอง
notes.presenter_no_engines: presenter ห้าม import engines (calc engines) — caller (app/) inject calcDistance/configs ผ่าน parameter
notes.plugins_self: plugins sub-modules can import each other (drivers, executor core wrapper, runtime)
notes.gateway_actions: gateway/index.ts imports gateway/actions for permission check before execute — same layer
notes.plugins_gateway: plugins/executor.ts uses gateway-adjacent supabase for audit logging via services
notes.services_self: services/supabase/realtime.ts imports from services/supabase/queries — same layer

core_gateway_edge_note: TASK-033 (registry/CHANGELOG.json DNA-000067, owner-approved AskUserQuestion decision: thin Gateway wrapper): core/auth/session.ts now imports gateway/auth.ts (getServerSupabaseClient) instead of importing services/supabase/server directly. This is the architecturally SANCTIONED pattern per CLAUDE.md (gateway = the one door), not a loosening of the core layer boundary — core -> services remains disallowed and unused anywhere in this repo (verified: core/auth/session.ts was the only real core/*.ts file importing services/ directly, and it no longer does).
